frontier_selector.why: The presence of violaceous discoloration, longitudinal ridging, thinning, and focal fragmentation of the nail plate, along with the histopathological findings of hyperkeratosis, hypergranulosis, acanthosis, basal cell degeneration, and dense bandlike lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, specifically support the diagnosis of Nail lichen planus.

support_spans: positive anti–hepatitis C virus antibody status
contradict_spans: positive anti–hepatitis C virus antibody status

support_spans: violaceous discoloration of 7 fingernails and 3 toenails
longitudinal ridging, thinning, and focal fragmentation of the nail plate
partial to complete loss of nail plate with oozing of blood resulting in hemorrhagic crusting of the nail beds and folds
